description:
No adopter binary carries a path inside this repository, because every projection target and generator command sits behind the boundary that already excludes this repository's own machinery from an adopter build.

## Background

Six modules each publish a pair of constants: the repository-relative path of a committed reference they project, and the command that regenerates it. Both name this checkout — a documentation path and a script path — and both are compiled into every adopter binary, where they mean nothing.

Every reader is already on one side of a boundary that exists. The declaration of this repository's generated artifacts is compiled only for the crate's own tests and the dev-dependency builds its entry point needs; the conformance assertions that read the constants are test-only. So the constants have no production reader, and moving them behind the same boundary removes them from an adopter build without changing what any of them does.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No projection target path or generator command naming this repository is reachable from a default library build.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each module's render function still produces the same bytes, and each conformance assertion still compares the committed file against that render.
- [hard] REQ-03: The declaration of this repository's generated artifacts still names every artifact's target and entry point, and the regeneration entry point behaves identically.
- [hard] REQ-04: The public surface of each module loses exactly those constants and nothing else.

## Notes

The reference this container's removals reshape is covered here once it has its final subject, so the move happens against the page that remains rather than the one being rewritten.
title: Stop naming this checkout's paths in the shipped binary
